items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section I, List of Answers on Terminology 4:1
items.html: Simple light is light that includes the vessel within it, to the point that no discernment is made between the light and the vessel. (Inner Light, Part 1, Chapter 1, Item 30)
